next.reason: 1985: 'References to the special register DEBUG-ITEM are restricted to references from within a debugging section.'; 2023: 'No clause holds the feature; the 2023 USE rules cover only EXCEPTION, EXCEPTION OBJECT/CONDITION and BEFORE REPORTING, not DEBUGGING.'. No 2023 clause holds the Debug feature, and the 2023 USE rules never mention USE FOR DEBUGGING or DEBUG-ITEM. The debugging section and its register are dropped.
